newsHighlights.title: With winter here, Inner Mongolia gets to the meat of the matter
newsHighlights.summary: As winter sets in, Inner Mongolia serves up hearty mutton dishes that keep locals warm and well-nourished during the harsh cold season.
newsHighlights.translation: 随着冬季来临，内蒙古端上丰盛的羊肉菜肴，帮助当地人在严寒中保持温暖与营养。

newsHighlights.title: Experience drone food delivery in Shenzhen
newsHighlights.summary: Shenzhen residents can now have meals flown to them by drone, making food delivery faster, hotter and more convenient.
newsHighlights.translation: 深圳市民如今可通过无人机送餐，让外卖更快、更热、更便捷。

newsHighlights.title: Giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang make public debut in Atlanta
newsHighlights.summary: Two giant pandas made their first public appearance in Atlanta, charming thousands of fans and highlighting wildlife conservation.
newsHighlights.translation: 两只大熊猫在亚特兰大首次公开亮相，萌翻数千名粉丝，也彰显了野生动物保护的意义。

newsHighlights.title: Governing the ocean, shaping our future
newsHighlights.summary: At the 7th Symposium on Global Maritime Cooperation, experts stressed that a healthy ocean is central to humanity's shared future.
newsHighlights.translation: 在全球海洋合作研讨会上，专家强调健康的海洋是人类共同未来的核心。

quote.quote: To keep the body in good health is a duty, otherwise we shall not be able to keep the mind strong and clear.
quote.author: Buddha
quote.translation: 保持身体健康是一种责任，否则我们将无法保持头脑坚强而清醒。
quote.explanation: 这句话强调身心一体：健康的身体是清晰思维与高效生活的基础，正呼应今日新闻中冬季饮食、健康生活方式的主题。

vocabulary.example: The giant pandas made their public debut in Atlanta and won the hearts of visitors.
vocabulary.translation: 两只大熊猫在亚特兰大公开亮相，赢得了游客的喜爱。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 "Giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang make public debut in Atlanta"。

vocabulary.example: Mutton is rich in protein, which helps the body stay strong through the cold months.
vocabulary.translation: 羊肉富含蛋白质，有助于身体在寒冷的月份保持强健。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "Inner Mongolia gets to the meat of the matter" 中冬季肉类饮食的营养价值。

vocabulary.definition: 恶劣的，严酷的（指气候或环境）
vocabulary.example: Inner Mongolia's harsh winter calls for a warmer and more nutritious diet.
vocabulary.translation: 内蒙古严酷的冬季需要更温暖、更有营养的饮食。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻中内蒙古冬季寒冷气候的描述。

vocabulary.example: A nutritious winter meal should include meat, vegetables and whole grains.
vocabulary.translation: 一顿有营养的冬季餐食应包含肉类、蔬菜和全谷物。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "Inner Mongolia gets to the meat of the matter" 中对冬季膳食营养的讨论。

vocabulary.example: Drone food delivery in Shenzhen cuts waiting time and keeps meals hot.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳的无人机送餐减少了等待时间，让餐食保持热度。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Experience drone food delivery in Shenzhen"。

vocabulary.example: Modern logistics technology allows hot food to reach customers within minutes.
vocabulary.translation: 现代物流技术让热食在几分钟内送达顾客手中。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻中无人机送餐背后的物流配送体系。

vocabulary.example: Regular exercise and enough sleep are both essential to our well-being.
vocabulary.translation: 规律运动与充足睡眠对我们的身心健康都至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻主题「健康与生活」中对生活方式与身心健康的整体关注。

vocabulary.example: A balanced diet helps strengthen the immune system during winter.
vocabulary.translation: 均衡的饮食有助于在冬季增强免疫系统。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联冬季健康饮食新闻，强调抵御寒冷与疾病的免疫力。

vocabulary.example: The pandas' debut also draws attention to wildlife conservation efforts.
vocabulary.translation: 大熊猫的亮相也引起了人们对野生动物保护行动的关注。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang make public debut in Atlanta" 及相关熊猫保护议题。

vocabulary.definition: 可持续的，能长期维持的
vocabulary.example: A healthy ocean is the foundation of a sustainable future for everyone.
vocabulary.translation: 健康的海洋是所有人可持续未来的基础。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Governing the ocean, shaping our future" 中关于海洋可持续发展的论述。

pattern.pattern: Keep ... out of ... （把……排除在……之外）
pattern.example: Keep geopolitics out of marine science.
pattern.translation: 让地缘政治远离海洋科学。
pattern.usage: 该句型表示「使某事物不进入某个领域或不介入某事」。常见搭配：keep stress out of your life（让压力远离生活）、keep junk food out of your diet（把垃圾食品挡在饮食之外）。口语和书面语中都常用，语气坚定、表达简洁。

grammar.title: with 复合结构（with + 名词 + 副词/形容词/分词）表伴随
grammar.explanation: 介词 with 后接名词，再跟补足语（副词、形容词、现在分词或过去分词），用来表示时间、伴随状态或原因，常置于句首作状语。例如 "With winter here" 中，winter 是名词，here 是副词作补足语，整体表示「随着冬天的到来」。这一结构能让句子更紧凑、信息更丰富，是新闻英语中的高频句式。
examples: With winter here, Inner Mongolia gets to the meat of the matter.
With drones buzzing overhead, hot meals reach Shenzhen customers in minutes.

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第一音节，首音节发 /deɪ/（同 day），第二音节发 /bjuː/（同 view）。不要读成「de-but」，也不要按法语习惯发 /deˈby/。常见错误是把重音放在第二音节。
examples: The giant pandas made their public debut in Atlanta.
Her debut novel became a bestseller within weeks.

reading.title: Winter Health: More Than Just a Warm Meal
reading.content:
As winter arrives in northern China, people naturally turn to richer, warmer food. In Inner Mongolia, local restaurants are serving hearty mutton dishes that provide the protein and energy the body needs to fight the cold. Nutritionists point out that a winter diet should balance meat with vegetables, grains and enough water, since dry indoor heating can easily dehydrate the body.

At the same time, technology is changing how we eat. In Shenzhen, residents can now order meals delivered by drone, cutting waiting time and keeping food hot. Faster delivery means fresher food and less waste.

Experts say staying healthy in winter is not only about diet. Regular exercise, enough sleep and time spent outdoors all strengthen the immune system. Whether a meal comes from a local kitchen or from the sky, the goal is the same: a balanced lifestyle that keeps both body and mind well.
reading.translation:
随着中国北方进入冬季，人们自然转向更丰盛、更温暖的食物。在内蒙古，当地餐馆供应热腾腾的羊肉菜肴，为身体提供抵御寒冷所需的蛋白质与能量。营养学家指出，冬季饮食应让肉类与蔬菜、谷物以及充足的水分保持平衡，因为室内供暖干燥容易使身体脱水。

与此同时，科技正在改变我们的饮食方式。在深圳，市民如今可以下单由无人机送来的餐食，缩短等待时间并让食物保持热度。更快的配送意味着更新鲜的食物和更少的浪费。

专家表示，冬季保持健康不仅仅关乎饮食。规律运动、充足睡眠以及户外活动时间都能增强免疫系统。无论一餐来自街边厨房还是来自天空，目标都是一致的：一种让身心皆安的平衡生活方式。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 新闻 "With winter here, Inner Mongolia gets to the meat of the matter" 与 "Experience drone food delivery in Shenzhen" 改写，并结合冬季健康常识补充而成，仅供英语学习使用。
